definitions.explanation: Paper specifically designed for writing letters, typically with lines or decorative borders. A staple item in Japanese stationery culture.

examples.english: I wrote a letter on writing paper.

notes:
Japan has a rich stationery culture, and {便箋|びんせん} comes in many designs, from simple lined paper to elaborate seasonal patterns. Often sold as a set together with ⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧ (envelopes). Handwritten letters on nice {便箋|びんせん} are considered more heartfelt than typed or digital messages.
